text: The lamps are already dark. The patrol has the earlier sensor return on display and proceeds with the stop.

"Power down the lights, captain."

$PersonRank $personName sends your sensor return beside the traffic plot for $entity.catchrelease_lampWhere.

"Whatever you're doing is interfering with the inhabited approaches. This is a warning. Shut it down and take the operation elsewhere."

"Hegemony Navy. Shut the device down."

$PersonRank $personName has your sensor return and the traffic plot side by side. "Unlicensed high-energy operation inside a protected navigation volume.
You have one warning."

"Kill the lights. Now."

"Corporate security. Your equipment is interfering with local operations."

$PersonRank $personName sends a notice to your comms console.

"Power it down. If you want to discuss authorization, do so before switching it back on."

"Extinguish it."

$PersonRank $personName looks past your bridge image toward the lamps.

"You were not given creation to cut at until something answers."

The traffic plot remains open.

"There are crews in those approaches, captain. Put the machine away from them."

The channel opens on a $manOrWoman already shouting.

"Kill it! Kill the lamp!"

$HeOrShe stabs a finger toward the sensor image.

"You wound God's work with Moloch's tools so you can drag supper through it, and you call that trade?"

Someone behind $himOrHer is shouting too.

"Extinguish it. Jettison it. Or we will do both for you."

"Kill the lights."

$personName points at a traffic plot. "You are lighting up half our scopes and upsetting people who pay us specifically not to be upset.
Do it somewhere emptier."

"Cease operation by order of the Sindrian Diktat."

$PersonRank $personName leaves the notice on screen.

"You are inside a volume under Sindrian authority, captain. Shut the apparatus down. I would prefer to record that you complied with the first instruction."

"League patrol. Power down the equipment."

$PersonRank $personName sends a notice citing the local navigation regulations.

"Those restrictions apply to industrial operations as well as weapons. Calling it fishing does not exempt you. This is your warning."

"Hey. Lights off."

$personName looks at the sensor plot. "I don't know what you've built. I know every instrument near $entity.catchrelease_lampWhere noticed it.
Take it somewhere nobody lives."
"You've had the warning." The previous incident sits open beside the new one. "$entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits. Pay it and shut the rig down."

"You were warned about operating that device."

$PersonRank $personName transmits the penalty notice.

"$entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits. Pay the fine and power down."

"We have a second incident on record."

$PersonRank $personName sends the assessment.

"$entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits. Further operation will result in an inspection and seizure of all catch aboard. Please don't make us send a team."

"You were asked once."

The first warning remains open beside the new incident.

"A warning is mercy when it is heard. Ignored, it becomes indulgence."

"The fine is $entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits."

"Pay it. Extinguish the lamps. Do not make another crew carry the cost of your choice."

"You kept it!"

The speaker is red-faced in the pickup.

"Of course you kept it. Moloch hands you a knife for creation and you haggle over the handle."

The figure flashes onto the channel.

"$entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits. Pay it if numbers are the only language you still understand."

"Then kill the lamp. Next time we come aboard."

"We asked nicely. Now it's $entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits."

$personName leaves the figure on screen.

"Lights off as well. You're paying for this time, not buying the next."

"The order to cease operation remains in force."

$PersonRank $personName sends a penalty notice for $entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits.

"You will pay that and shut the device down. A further breach will bring an inspection party aboard your ship."

"Second recorded instance. $entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS credits."

$PersonRank $personName closes the first notice and opens another. "The third provision authorizes inspection and seizure. I'd rather not spend my afternoon invoking it.
Pay the fine and shut the rig down."
"You again." $personName puts the figure on-screen. "$entity.catchrelease_lampFineDGS. Lights off. I'd like this to be the last time I learn something new about fishing."

"Power down and prepare for inspection."

$PersonRank $personName sends the boarding order.

"We're seizing all the catch aboard, including anything packed in crates. Have your cargo records ready and keep your crew clear of the inspection team."

"Hegemony Navy. Heave to. Prepare to be boarded."

The officer does not read the warning history back to you. "You ignored the warning and the fine. We are inspecting the rig and seizing all catch aboard, including packed crates.
Cut the lights."

"The previous notices have apparently been insufficient."

$PersonRank $personName transmits a boarding order.

"Power down and stand by for inspection. All catch aboard is subject to seizure, including packed crates. Your cooperation will keep this from becoming a security incident."

"Power it down."

"You were warned, then fined. You have continued to put this work before the safety of every soul in those approaches."

The order is signed.

"We are coming aboard. What you brought back while using those lamps will not remain with you."

"Drives cold! Lamps cold!"

The speaker is close enough to the pickup for the image to shake with each word.

"We are coming aboard for what you dragged out under Moloch's light."

A weapon is shoved into view from somewhere behind $himOrHer.

"Touch a control and we'll count that as your answer."

"All right, captain. You've had the cheap versions." A boarding shuttle separates from the formation. "Lights off. Hold open."

The speaker glances past the camera, then back. "And don't make me put a price on resisting."

"Prepare to be boarded."

$PersonRank $personName signs the authorization.

"Your equipment will be inspected and all catch aboard seized, including packed crates. Shut it down now. I will not repeat the order while our people are crossing."

"The fine did not settle this, so we are proceeding to inspection."

$PersonRank $personName sends the boarding authorization.

"Power down. The team will examine your records and seize all catch aboard, including packed crates."

$personName has the boarding authorization ready.

"I told you I didn't want to learn more about this. Apparently I do."

"Shut it down. We'll need your cargo records, and we're taking all the catch aboard, including packed crates."

"We've recorded repeated violations and repeated orders to stop."

$PersonRank $personName turns toward the tactical display.

"No further notices, captain."

The other ships move to engage.

"Further operation of the prohibited device is confirmed."

$PersonRank $personName closes the incident record.

"You've had repeated orders to cease. Engagement is authorized."

The Hegemony formation begins to spread.

"Security has authorized force."

$PersonRank $personName closes the incident file.

"We gave you several opportunities to stop operating the device. You've declined all of them."

The link closes as the formation spreads.

$PersonRank $personName is not alone at the screen this time, and nobody behind $himOrHer is speaking.

"We asked. We fined. We took what you had taken. And here it is again, burning over people."

"Ludd forgive you. We will not."

The link closes.

The channel opens to shouting.

"There! There it is again! Moloch's lantern!"

The speaker wipes spittle from the pickup with the heel of a hand.

"You cut at God's creation for meat and credits and still you light it again?"

Someone behind $himOrHer screams, "Break it!"

"No more bargains. Break the lamps. Break the hands that light them."

The link cuts. The Path ships accelerate.

"Again? After all that?"

$personName looks away from the pickup and gives an order.

"I've spent enough time asking you."

The channel drops. The pirate ships accelerate toward your fleet.

"You have repeatedly defied a direct order of the Sindrian Diktat."

$PersonRank $personName signs the finding.

"Force is authorized."

Weapons come online across the formation.

$PersonRank $personName closes the incident record.

"The previous stops are all on file. Command has authorized engagement."

$HeOrShe glances at the tactical display.

"We are done discussing the regulations."

"You keep doing it."

$personName looks more tired than angry.

"I've got people to answer to as well, captain."

The channel closes. Your sensors officer calls out weapons coming online.

"The order tells you what I can accept. If it names a species, that's what the kitchen wants. If it doesn't, I have room to choose."

The provisioner brings the request back up. "Same with size, condition and how it was caught. Check those before you go fishing."

"Because it's on the menu. People have booked tables for it. One of them has already told me how it ought to be prepared."

The chef folds the ingredient list toward you. "I'd rather give them the dish than an explanation. Can you get the catch?"
"Precisely." The factor smiles. "Even with conservative estimates."

"Coherence, returned mass, structural variance. Then the same measurements again, with the instruments recalibrated."

The researcher shows you a pair of readings from one specimen. "These disagree. I need more examples before I can say anything useful about why. A colleague suggested discarding the first reading, which would make the table look much better and tell us absolutely nothing."

"Something low-coherence. First we show them a good specimen, so they know what they're looking at. Then we show them the one they won't agree about."

"Because then it isn't a complete survey. We'd lose the classification, explain the omission, and still have an expense claim for the time spent trying to fill it."

The officer closes the filing instructions. "I'd rather finish the entry. So would the captain."

"Good company on a long passage. Thorough about the work. Thorough about other people's work, too, which could be less welcome."

The convoy master looks back at the will. "They would have checked this clause before departure. I should have done the same."
